items.Sentence: At the treatment plant, wastewater passes through a static screen and distribution box split equally to the two aeration basins.
The sewer system consists of a control building, headworks, two shotcrete-lined aeration basins subdivided into four cells, and three unlined percolation/ evaporation ponds.
The sewer system consists of a control building, headworks, two shotcrete-lined aeration basins subdivided into four cells, and three unlined percolation/evaporation ponds.
Wastewater flows from the aeration cells by gravity to the three storage reservoirs with compacted soil liners.

All effluent is used to irrigate landscaping on site during dry weather months, typically May through August. Effluent is pumped from Storage Reservoir 3 though a 6-inch PVC pipeline to three land application areas (LAAs) located north of the treatment facility: the West Spray Field (21 acres), the East Spray Field (14.8 acres), and the flood irrigation area (6.2 acres divided into 5 terraces).
The Main Pump Station consists of two wet wells and two submersible pumps with a capacity of 340-470 gallons per minute (gpm, 0.45 mgd).
WDR Order 99-090 permitted the discharge of untreated and chlorinated wastewater to LAAs.
